prompt: Design a minimalist poster with high-end commercial aesthetics. The core visual language is "real objects passing through a geometric emotional window." Set a long, narrow low-saturation soft color as a visual anchor. Place a photorealistic object inside, letting parts of it break the frame to create a sense of growth. Keep the background minimalist with nearly transparent topographic lines or light/shadow contours. The layout should resemble high-end real estate or aesthetic magazines with slender, restrained text.
